content:
The FischFright 3 update brings new masks to Fisch, including the Leviathan Mask, Mojo Mask, Vampiric Mask, and Blobfish Mask. These masks can help you improve your event progress and increase your chances of finding rare items, including relics and Plushie Nessie.

To get the new masks, you need to find the Flying Dutchman, a mobile merchant that flies around the map. Finding the ship can be tricky, but you can make the search easier by reaching one of the game’s highest peaks and increasing your graphics settings.

Here is how to find the Flying Dutchman and get the FischFright 3 masks.

  • How to get all masks in FischFright 3
  • All FischFright masks, prices, and effects
  • How to choose the right mask
  • FAQs

You can get the masks by locating the Flying Dutchman and purchasing the available items from its shop. Follow these steps to reach the merchant.

1. Find the Flying Dutchman

The Flying Dutchman is a mobile merchant aboard a flying ship. Unlike a regular shop with a fixed location, you need to search the sky to find it.

To make the search easier, travel to one of the highest peaks on the map. Once you reach the top, increase your in-game graphics settings so you can see distant objects more clearly.

Look around the surrounding sky for the Flying Dutchman’s ship. You may need to scan different directions before spotting it.

2. Use your glider to reach the ship

Once you have located the Flying Dutchman, equip your glider and jump from the peak toward the ship.

Aim carefully and adjust your direction while gliding so that you can land aboard the flying vessel. Make sure you have enough distance to reach it before jumping.

If you miss the ship, return to a suitable elevated position and try again.

3. Open the shop and purchase the masks

After landing on the Flying Dutchman, interact with the merchant to open the shop interface.

Browse the available masks and check their descriptions before making a purchase. Each mask has its own cost and effects, so choose one that suits your current objective.

The Blobfish Mask is particularly useful if you are trying to find rare relics or Plushie Nessie, while other masks may be more suitable for progressing through the FischFright event.

All FischFright masks, prices, and effects

The masks associated with FischFright offer different bonuses, ranging from increased event-currency earnings to improved chances of finding rare items.

The following table summarizes the prices and effects provided for the masks. Some details, particularly the prices and effects of the newly mentioned Mojo and Vampiric Masks, still need confirmation from the in-game shop.

How to choose the right mask

Your best option depends on what you want to accomplish during FischFright.

  • For rare relics and Plushie Nessie: Consider the Blobfish Mask, keeping its reduced Treat earnings in mind.
  • For event-currency farming: The Megalodon Mask’s listed 20% currency bonus may be useful.
  • For improving Treat outcomes: Consider the Scylla Mask’s listed success-rate bonus.
  • For event fishing: Compare the Leviathan and Mossjaw Mask descriptions in the shop.
  • For a milestone reward: Work toward the Zombie Nessie Mask requirements.

FAQs

How do you get onto the Flying Dutchman?

Use a glider to travel from a high peak toward the ship. Aim for the vessel and land aboard it to access the merchant.

Which mask is best for finding Plushie Nessie?

The Blobfish Mask is the option identified in the supplied details for increasing the chances of finding Plushie Nessie and rare relics. Its listed bonus is 50%, but it also halves Treat earnings from trick-or-treating.

Is the Zombie Nessie Mask available from the Flying Dutchman?

The Zombie Nessie Mask is listed as a free milestone reward rather than a shop purchase. Its stated requirements are Hex Stage V, 200 Hex Energy, and 80% FischFright Bestiary progress.
